name: Fluid Power: Hydraulics & Pneumatics
summary: Transmitting and controlling power with pressurised liquids and gases: pumps, actuators, valves, circuits and electro-hydraulic control.

topics.name: Fluid power fundamentals: Pascal's law, power and efficiency; hydraulic vs pneumatic vs electric
Hydraulic fluids, contamination control and filtration
Hydraulic pumps: gear, vane and piston; fixed and variable displacement
Hydraulic actuators: cylinder sizing, cushioning and buckling; hydraulic motors
Directional control valves and circuit symbols (ISO 1219)
Pressure control valves: relief, reducing, sequence and counterbalance
Flow control valves and speed-control circuits (meter-in, meter-out, bleed-off)
Accumulators, reservoirs, coolers, hoses and fittings
Hydraulic circuit design and analysis (regenerative, synchronising, hi-lo circuits)
Pneumatic systems: compressors, air preparation (FRL), cylinders and valves
Pneumatic circuit design, vacuum systems and grippers
Electro-pneumatic and electro-hydraulic control with PLCs
Losses, heat generation and troubleshooting of hydraulic systems
